objective: Repair generation-input asymmetry and compare a bounded public-capability planning agent with contemporaneous text-only zero-shot and non-generative controls.
public_inputs: Same exact mission intent, opaque randomized task ID, supported action descriptions/targets/risks and six diagnostic-archetype public definitions in both groups. No readable mission ID, gold profile, guards, weights, diagnostic values, realized labels, costs or outcomes.
candidate_budget: Exactly three distinct ranked actions per six archetypes requested. Primary evaluation takes first three distinct returned action-name strings, retaining unsupported names for verifier rejection; native output and violations separately retained. Historical P4 zero uses same first3 cap. Broad/embedding controls use first3 for primary matched-budget evaluation, native retained descriptively. Full library remains an explicit six-action ceiling.
agent: Call 1 proposes two contrasting complete candidate plans and up to three exact mission-text evidence spans, then calls assess_public_plan. The real tool checks schema/support, verifies literal evidence spans, computes target coverage by public archetype, and returns public action capabilities/risks for proposed choices. It does not infer hidden guards or supply scores. Call 2 chooses or revises final candidates using this feedback. No adaptive expansion beyond this one tool round. Zero-shot receives all same public definitions; only computation and interaction differ.
failure_handling: Retain all API, parse, tool and schema failures. Retry only transient transport/HTTP429/5xx at most twice; never regenerate because of quality or measured outcome. Missing/unparseable final outputs yield empty candidates handled by unchanged fallback/escalation. Cache receipts and resume without regenerating completed policies.
inference: Average 12 sample seeds and all three generation replicates within each of 48 original missions. Paired 10000 mission-bootstrap draws and 10000 sign-flips, two-sided add-one p values. One local 28-test Holm family; also submit every raw p to global expanded family. Fixed first24/second24 theme pairing gives separate 24-pair sensitivity, not additional primary hypotheses. All directions/non-significant results retained. Primary inference seed 20260912083.
cohort_caveat: Opaque zero versus historical semantic-ID P4 zero is generation-cohort sensitivity: date, service alias behavior and explicitly shared archetype specification differ; no pure causal ID effect is claimed. Contemporaneous opaque-input comparisons answer input fairness.
evaluation: Same original 48 mission evaluator, original DES posteriors/labels, 12 fixed source-window seeds and160 windows per mission seed. Full-information feasible oracle and unchanged posterior guards/selector. Independent scalar checks against original functions. Each generated group has276480 decision exposures, each across3 generations; exact total 48*12*160*3=276480 per group.
offline_outputs: Exact public inputs, opaque-ID private join map, frozen protocol/hash receipt, all request/response/tool traces, final candidates, per-window selections/regret/invalidity, mission/replicate summaries, 28 raw tests, code and full manifests. Costs measured by calls, successful/attempted elapsed time, input/output tokens; no inferred monetary charges.
